plan: Implement CheckInConsole as a deterministic action-driven state machine.
Validate each action before mutating the public session dictionary.
Centralize prompt, error, and appointment-choice screen construction.
Keep input and output behind read_action() and display() collaborators for unittest fakes.
mechanisms: Atomic validation-before-mutation preserves accepted session data on malformed actions.
A single screen factory enforces the exact prompt/messages/choices shape and appointment ordering.
In-place session reset preserves the public session dictionary while restoring its exact four-key schema.
Dependency-injected action_source and screen_sink provide replaceable standard-library-only I/O boundaries.
